column3: GitHub funding metadata; only open_collective is set, every other platform is a commented placeholder - and it is the ONLY file in .github/, so the repo has no CI at all
one-line ignore rule (resources/qm/*.*) and the repo's ONLY ignore rule; the *.* pattern keeps the committed resources/qm/readme while ignoring every generated .qm
6-line qmake stub: sets BUILD_DIR=$$PWD then includes ../SimulIDE.pri; the committed build_XX folder name is a literal placeholder and there is no install target

verbatim FSF GNU Affero General Public License v3, 662 lines; confirmed via title/preamble, END OF TERMS AND CONDITIONS marker and the How-to-Apply appendix (middle is unmodified boilerplate, not read line by line)
licence grant: program under GPL-or-AGPL v3 'or later', author files pinned to AGPL-3.0, third-party contributions under GPL-3.0 - a per-author licence split
61-line pitch and build instructions (Qt5 modules, cd build_XX && qmake && make); documents neither the -nogui nor the -test flag that main.cpp implements

the entire build system: recursive source globs, 61-line flat INCLUDEPATH, AngelScript-driven -Wno flags, -Ofast with a stripped debug block, per-OS blocks (macOS hardcodes a Homebrew gcc-7 path), build-date stamp and the lrelease PRE_TARGETDEPS step

283-line Qt resource manifest with flat aliases; embeds fonts, 14 git-ignored .qm translations, 11 syntax files and 224 icons, but NOT the 154 help .txt files or resources/data (diodes.model, images) the runtime path resolvers expect

134-line entry point: custom qInstallMessageHandler feeding both the app debug pane and stderr, Windows AttachConsole, locale/translator resolution before the UI exists, and the argv surface -nogui / -test <folder> / file, all deferred by QTimer::singleShot(500)

459-line app shell: QSettings persistence, DPI-derived font scale, three-pane splitter layout, F5=power-on, crash recovery from a fixed backup.sim2, the headless hideGui() that also disables autosave, the 6-step help lookup with #include expansion, and the user/config/resource path resolvers

145-line declaration of the root window and the app's most-used API; holds the Langs enum with commented-out languages duplicated in mainwindow.cpp, the self() singleton, and the path-resolution contract in a comment

276-line shared leaf: absolute-SI multiplier table, hex/base formatting, quote and path helpers, four file readers that name their caller in the error, and the 4px/8px canvas grid arithmetic with a negative-x branch in roundDown

101-line utility header: the unitToVal/valToUnit macro pair (prefix choice coupled to decimal count, not exact inverses), file-reader declarations, grid helpers and the ordered set-difference template
